title: the clerk reads whose a claim is, and whose a task is, from the issue's labels alone
status: fixed after 0.4.1: a claim is the worker's its claim file names, the labels deciding only where no file names one, and a task the labels of several workers give goes to the first of them in the team's order with nothing else to do (team.Snapshot.holder, team.moves_from; DESIGN.md, 13)

steps.note: #1 is given to a and to b, #2 to a alone, and #3 is in the Queue

a takes #2, given to it alone, b #1, which the labels of a and b give, and c #3. Until the fix the clerk dealt #1 to neither, since its labels name two workers, and b #3, which the mutant "a shared task dealt to none" shows; "a shared task before one given alone" deals a #1 (G14)
b, the first of the two to claim #1, holds it; its session stops before its Announce, as a worker in Actions' can, so the issue still carries a's label and b's and no claimed
c's claim waits on a peer or the coordinator

b carries its claim, whose file names it, though the issue's labels name a too and no Announce has come; a takes #2; c, whose claim waits, nothing. Until the fix nobody carried #1, its labels naming two workers, so b's claim lay idle until its release; the mutant "the clerk carrying by labels alone" tells a, the first they name, to carry b's claim, and "a blocked claim carried" tells c to carry its waiting claim (G14)

Announce takes every other worker's label off, one an earlier claim left or one that gave the issue to several, so from here the labels name the holder alone, as the claim file does: the coordinator gave #1 to a too, and a's label would otherwise name a wherever no claim file is read
